items.html: But the matter will be understood with what was stated above, for they were already born at first, and she nursed them, and afterward, so, after nine years, she returned and became pregnant from them, in the secret of a second Ibur for the need of the Mochin of birth, and afterward she brought them forth, etc. And first we shall explain this second Ibur: how is it possible? For behold, it is written, 'in the image of Elokim He made man,' and 'from my flesh I shall behold God,' and this matter cannot be in the lower man, that he should return in the secret of an Ibur in his mother's womb after being born. And to understand this, we must explain the matter of the Mayin Nukvin and their ascent, mentioned in every place — what their matter is.
